## Validation and handoff

Five screened-in records formed the **development set**; the strategy retrieved all five (100% relative recall on that set). This is not an independent validation set and does not establish sensitivity or complete recall. No in-scope systematic-review benchmark was identified. One retained record has a later displayed publication year but was present in PubMed by the required Entrez cutoff.

The [full audit](</C:/Users/aaron/AppData/Local/Temp/psb-evals/run-1ea9c6b0d2472c4a/lean-fixes-codex-noseed-20261002T133634Z/work/audit.md>), [validation manifest](</C:/Users/aaron/AppData/Local/Temp/psb-evals/run-1ea9c6b0d2472c4a/lean-fixes-codex-noseed-20261002T133634Z/work/validation-manifest.json>), and [working rationale](</C:/Users/aaron/AppData/Local/Temp/psb-evals/run-1ea9c6b0d2472c4a/lean-fixes-codex-noseed-20261002T133634Z/work/narrative.md>) are in `./work`.
